text: {"lessons":["My account fell about 8% from Period 1 to Period 10, so I need to monitor cumulative losses, not just month-to-month changes.","Doing nothing through several declines did not stop the account from losing value; I should review my holdings and risk level regularly rather than equating patience with a plan.","Selling Stock E below my average cost did not guarantee better results afterward, so I should base trades on my overall needs and evidence—not on the urge to recover a loss."]}
